# A 100.00 USD invoice overpaid with 200.00 USD into a USD bank.
#
# The bank now holds 200.00 USD and the customer is owed 100.00 back. GnuCash
# leaves two splits on the receivable: the one that settles the invoice, and
# the overpayment, a credit balance on A/R.
#
# Both are currency the book holds, at the cost the invoice was booked at, so
# both are cost bases — the overpayment is a borrowing in the shape of the A/P
# side, the same as `fx_buy_and_borrow_usd.txt`'s loan. What this fixture
# produces in `fx-balances`:
#
#   Assets:Accounts Receivable USD   1.4 CAD/USD   100.00 USD   (the invoice)
#   Assets:Accounts Receivable USD   1.4 CAD/USD   100.00 USD   (overpaid)
#   Available USD: 200.00 USD
#
# Counting only the first left the book claiming 100.00 USD sellable while its
# bank held 200.00, so selling what it actually had was refused.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_foreign_currency_cost_basis.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD-OVER"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-OVER"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 200
		account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		prepayment: 100
		memo: "Payment for INV-USD-OVER"
